Items.Name: [Dub][Premium] Do You Like Big Girls?
Items.Overview: Sota was suddenly made dorm manager and coach of the Hokuei University Women's Volleyball Club as prompted by his older sister, Kaori. There, he had a fateful reunion with Ayano, his first love... In the girls' dorm! In the gym! In a hotel?! What awaited him were days of being bossed around by girls bigger than him! A Happy Harem Rom-Com of Size Differences♡ Born Huge on the Northern Plains!!

Items.Name: [Unedited] Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
Items.Overview: Now I can see how much my crush likes me──… ──I lack the courage to confess to my childhood friend, Marika. One day, I make a strong wish upon a shooting star: To read someone's feelings like in a dating sim. The very next day, much to my surprise, that wish came true…?! Lovemeters now appear over the girls in my class. Confused by this surreal sight, I check Marika's, only to find her meter's plummeted to the rotten depths of hell...?! Marika, if you hate me, then why were you always so kind...? What are Marika's hidden true feelings? Does she really hate me, or...?!

Items.Name: [Dub] Henkei Shoujo
Items.Overview: What would you do if a girl close to you suddenly morphs into a vehicle? A never-before-seen characterization of beautiful girls that entirely change form! Check out each episode for more details!

Items.Name: Kanokon: The Girl Who Cried Fox
Items.Overview: Kouta, a country boy, just recently relocated to the city, is dragged into supernatural events as a result of his contact with two girls, one who gives "foxy" new meaning and another howling after him.  Things are looking up for his love life.

Items.Name: Adam's Sweet Agony
Items.Overview: Set in a world where all of humanity has become impotent due to the aftereffects of a pandemic, it depicts male high school student Kazuki, the only human with a healthy lower half, living a throbbing harem life surrounded by kind, friendly upperclassmen, unsatisfied female teachers, the academy’s prince, an affluent family’s young lady, and other girls in an academy full of women.

Items.Name: Okusama wa Michael [Second Night: Bondage?! Battle?! Brilliant Transformation]
Items.Overview: The latest work by Yoshiten as director and character designer is here! The newly weds, Mika and Shinichi, are in love every day! One day, Mika encounters an alien called Frue. Meanwhile, Shinichi has been subjected to humiliation, brainwashed by his colleagues, Saeko and Yume! Will Mika be able to save her beloved husband?! Will they be able to get their love life back?! The erotic transformation love comedy comes to a finale with high-quality animation including a couple's love-making and humiliating sex!

Items.Name: Reincarnated into Demon King Evelogia's World
Items.Overview: After getting shot, Gozu wakes up in the world of a game that he loves… There he meets his favorite character, the final boss of the game 'Demon King Evelogia'! "I fell in love with you!" Gozu confesses to Eve and…!?

Items.Name: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
Items.Overview: How does someone as perfect as me get turned on by a guy who's so... ordinary?! 【Narcissistic Playboy x Average Guy with a Secret Sexy Side】 Get ready for a BL rom-com packed with sass and irresistible charm! Kaji’s good looks and charm have made him popular with everyone at his office. However, beneath the surface, he secretly looks down on others and judges them by a scoring system! One day, Kaji finds himself on an overnight business trip with his bland colleague, Fukami. Unimpressed by the plain-looking Fukami, Kaji vows that even if they were the last two people on a deserted island, he would never consider sleeping with him! At least, that’s what he thought... until he glimpsed Fukami coming out of the shower and realized his irresistibly cute and erotic side!

Items.Name: Futari Ecchi (OVA)
Items.Overview: Yura meets a run-of-the-mill guy named Makoto during a matchmaking date. They hit off on their first meet, going on frequent dates, then finally tying the knot. After sharing their first night as newlyweds, they build a strong bond in marriage and spend their first Christmas together...

Items.Name: Love From Above! A Girl Fell from the 2nd Floor
Items.Overview: The best thing living in this old apartment is that there is a beautiful landlady and a girl living upstairs of me. One day the ceiling comes falling down onto me with the girl and...!? A miracle happening which leads to a life living with two girls. How will this love triangle settle??

Items.Name: Nukitashi THE ANIMATION
Items.Overview: Seiran Island, a tropical eden where people are free to act on their desires under a uniquely libertine law. But even here in paradise, there are those who work in the shadows to bring it down… United, these misfits stand side by side as the secret society NLNS. As their founder and head honcho, I, Junnosuke Tachibana, won’t stop until we’ve crushed this crazy law once and for all! I’ve even found a benefactor in this crusty old rich guy, name unknown… He’s hooked us up with a secret base and a buttload of cash already. In return, he wants us to find someone and “protect her at all costs.” Apparently, she holds the key to our mission’s success…? In this case, there’s only one thing to do: locate this mystery girl. And all while keeping the SHO off our scent, too…

Items.Name: Seduced by My Best Friend
Items.Overview: Shion and Rui are the dream team when it comes to hitting on women. Tonight was going to be another night of hooking up with girls for Shion, but he ended up taking a strange drug. When he woke up... he'd turned into a girl?! Rui came looking for Shion, but didn't recognize him, and started hitting on him...

Items.Name: [Dub][Premium] Guilty Hole ～ Room of Guilty Pleasure
Items.Overview: "Please pick your favorite student..." This overworked and underpaid teacher, Mr. Sasaki, has his whole life turned upside down when he stumbles upon the "Guilty Hole." He thinks it's a dream when he sees the student's shoe lockers have been transformed into selection panels... seeing one that catches his eye, he joking picks her... When she appears in his classroom in the middle of the night, throwing insults at him, but her eyes seem to linger on him, tinged with embarassment. "I'll finish this quickly so... Don't hold back, ok...?" Thus begins a forbidden relationship... Welcome to the Guilty Hole, where anything is allowed--

Items.Name: [Dub] [Premium]  Ichigo Aika: Strawberry Elegy
Items.Overview: My step-sister from Dad's remarriage was a hardcore gal—the complete opposite of me...! Even after moving in together, Aika keeps bringing guys home and doing whatever she wants, driving Kota crazy. But after a certain incident, she starts demanding hugs from him, and more...!? A bumpy step-sibling romance comedy between a sassy gal and a nit-picky, straight-laced step brother bursts onto the scene!

Items.Name: Kakushite! Makinasan!
Items.Overview: Eita Akutsu is a loner and an introverted mecha otaku. One night, the cheerful and popular gyaru, Makina Agatsuma, suddenly appears in his apartment. But something seems off about her. When she abruptly strips in front of him… what he sees is not a human body, but a mechanical one! Makina is an AI robot designed for intimacy, yet she's been restricted from accessing any adult-related information. Eita, on the other hand, is a pure-hearted virgin who is extremely awkward with anything lewd. Thus begins their top-secret cohabitation, where no one must find out her true nature!

Items.Name: [Unedited] Does it Count if You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?
Items.Overview: Akane Tsuda (28), working at a major electronics manufacturer, impulsively buys something while drunk—something that guarantees a felony just for possession!? It was Nadeshiko, an illegally manufactured adult romance android!? Akane finds herself at Nadeshiko's mercy, but despite being toyed with, she's drawn to Nadeshiko's various impressive skills...? The single office lady and the android begin their naughty cohabitation life together!!

Items.Name: Puni Puni Poemy
Items.Overview: Puni Puni Poemy is a spin-off series after Excel Saga. Same style, same wackiness. The story revolves around Poemy, the daughter of Nabeshin (this wacky character from Excel Saga gets married with Yamamusume Kumi-Kumi and there comes Poemy). As the real name of Nabeshin is Shinichi Watanabe, of course naturally, Poemy's full name is Poemy Watanabe.

Items.Name: Monster Musume: Everyday Life with Monster Girls
Items.Overview:
Monsters—they're real, and they want to date us! Three years ago, the world learned that harpies, centaurs, catgirls, and all manners of fabulous creatures are not merely fiction; they are flesh and blood—not to mention scale, feather, horn, and fang. Thanks to the "Cultural Exchange Between Species Act," these once-mythical creatures have assimilated into society, or at least, they're trying.

When a hapless human named Kurusu Kimihito is inducted as a "volunteer" into the government exchange program, his world is turned upside down. A snake-like lamia named Miia comes to live with him, and it is Kurusu's job to take care of her and make sure she integrates into his everyday life. Unfortunately for Kurusu, Miia is undeniably sexy, and the law against interspecies breeding is very strict. Even worse, when a ravishing centaur girl and a flirtatious harpy move in, what's a full-blooded young man with raging hormones to do?!

Items.Name: Iketeru Futari
Items.Overview: Meet Saji Keisuke, a hormone-heavy teen who's fallen hopelessly in love with Koizumi, a supposed man hater who refuses to give him the time of day. All he wants is to get laid, but all Koizumi wants is to get as far from him as possible! With plenty of love for Koizumi (in his pants?!) and plenty of distractions to keep at bay (such as big breasted Yuki), can our hero manage to get past second base with the girl of his dreams, or is she destined to stay just in his dreams forever?

Items.Name: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, the Side Character?!
Items.Overview:
Side Character — Unimportant. Constantly getting in the way of the main characters' love story.

After finding himself reincarnated into the world of a novel, Loneal goes to great lengths to steer clear of Prince Alec, the hero, to avoid disrupting the main storyline between Alec and the heroine, Lily. However, to Loneal's great surprise, the prince becomes infatuated with...him?!

"A charming physique, such as yours, more than makes up for your lack of experience."

Before he knows it, he finds himself melting into the prince's arms... Why is everything so different from the novel?!
